messages:
maria-support: FYI - AcmeCorp raised a ticket: manager dashboards show 0 activity for 'ops' role for 2026-03-16 while they say API returns events. They've attached screenshots and a curl repro. Threading this here to triage.

elena-support: Can you paste the curl they used and the exact dashboard name? Also need org id and affected role id.

maria-support: Org: acme-corp (linked_org_id=12345). Role: ops (role_id=ops-9). Dashboard: Team Activity > Manager view. Curl they ran:
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-live-*****" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/metrics?org=12345&role=ops&start=2026-03-16T00:00:00Z&end=2026-03-16T23:59:59Z"
```
Response: returns 312 events.

devin-eng: Interesting — dashboard query uses aggregated store which applies retention + permission filters. Can you check Last-Modified of metrics index for that org?

maria-support: I pulled the logs, looks like retention prune ran at 2026-03-16T02:00Z. But raw events exist in raw_store. Screenshot: https://redwood.slack-files/acme-ss.png

jeff-sre: Also saw errors from permissions-sync around that time: `permissions-sync: fetch roles for linked_org_id=12345 failed: 504 Gateway Timeout` — job retried at 02:15 and succeeded at 02:47.

tim-product: If the aggregated index delete ran while permissions were temporarily empty, the delete job might have applied org-level TTL instead of role-scoped retention. That could explain manager view dropping rows.

sam-security: Confirmed in auth logs: at 02:05 the role mapping for ops-9 returned empty due to scaledown of permissions-cache; subsequent queries to analytics API returned 403 with `filter_evaluation_missing_role` until 02:47. Here's the log snippet:
```
analytics: query 0x7f3 failed - 403 filter_evaluation_missing_role role=ops-9
```

devin-eng: Repro steps I ran locally: 1) simulate empty role map 2) run retention prune 3) aggregated index drops role buckets. So yes, race condition between permissions-sync and retention job.

maria-support: Customer is asking for a rollback or recovery. Any quick mitigation?

devin-eng: Short-term: 1) re-run permissions-sync to restore role map if not already done (it succeeded at 02:47 here). 2) Run an index backfill for the affected date range from raw_store -> aggregated_store for linked_org_id=12345, role_id=ops-9. I can run the backfill if support approves.

elena-support: I'll ask AcmeCorp for consent to run backfill and inform them of ETA.

tim-product: Let's also add a guard to retention job: skip prune if role mappings are stale (>1 min) and re-check. I'll file a JIRA.

jeff-sre: Also scheduling a one-off retention-scan to identify other orgs that had permissions-sync failures around 2026-03-16 02:00Z.

deploy-bot: deploy pipeline #r1456 passed — added feature flag 'retention-perm-guard' disabled by default.

sam-security: Note for compliance: record of any backfill must be logged and consented. Please cc compliance if needed.

maria-support: Customer consented via ticket. Please run backfill and keep me posted. I'll update ticket 7894.

devin-eng: Starting backfill job now: backfill-job-9876 for org 12345 role ops-9 date 2026-03-16. ETA ~30m. Will post progress.

devin-eng: backfill-job-9876: 50% done (republishing aggregates)

devin-eng: backfill-job-9876: complete. Aggregated store shows 312 events matching raw API. Can someone verify dashboard?

elena-support: Confirmed with customer in ticket — manager dashboard now shows expected counts. Customer happy. Closing loop.

maria-support: Thanks all. Action items: tim - JIRA for retention guard; jeff - scan other orgs; sam - update compliance note; devin - add idempotency to prune. I'll summarize in ticket.
